title: Understanding Standardization
text: Standardizing a dataset means adjusting the values so that the mean of each column is $$0$$ and the variance is $$1$$. This process helps in comparing different datasets on a similar scale. Think about how this might affect the model's ability to generalize.

title: Impact of Standardization on Overfitting
text: Consider how standardizing the training set might influence the model's performance on unseen data. Does it make the model more flexible or more rigid? How does this relate to overfitting?

title: Evaluating the Effect of Standardization
text: When you standardize the training set, does it change the underlying patterns in the data? Think about whether this process introduces any bias or variance that could lead to overfitting.
